name: web
description: Search the web with domain filters and fetch public pages for focused AI-assisted answers.

configSchema.label: Search provider
configSchema.hint: Which service powers WebSearch. Automatic uses Tavily when its key is set, otherwise Serper.

configSchema.label: Tavily API key
configSchema.hint: app.tavily.com — powers WebSearch. Without a key here or in Serper only WebFetch works.

configSchema.label: Serper API key
configSchema.hint: serper.dev — Google results for WebSearch. Without a key here or in Tavily only WebFetch works.
